_meta.description: Curated palettes harvested from public palette community charts (trending/popular/latest, 48 each; style-filter URLs proved to be SEO fallback clones of popular — do not use). tier = crowd signal (3>=50K likes, 2>=20K, 1>0, 0 new/unranked); occurrences = cross-page recurrence; computed_styles from HSL stats; flags from objective gates (CB-COLLISION-RISK / SLOP-SIGNATURE / NARROW-LIGHTNESS). Gates reject only broken architecture, never judge beauty — final judgment happens in context at use time.
